pairs.evidence: crates/core/tests/llm_chokepoint.rs:109 A rustfmt-wrapped `.research(` line has an empty receiver and is dropped here (the form already exists at crates/apps/connector-api-watch/src/lib.rs:558), so a new wrapped direct Researcher call inside core passes the model-chokepoint inventory with nothing reported.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/tests/llm_chokepoint.rs:109 The wrapped-chain form is neither followed nor refused; it silently reads as no call site. enforcement_preview.rs joins lines and fixtures this exact case, this scanner does not.

crates/core/tests/llm_chokepoint.rs:130 Compliance is keyed on the receiver's name: inside core, where the pub(crate) layer does not help, `let ctx = self.engines.researcher(); ctx.research(req)` is exempt with behaviour unchanged.
crates/core/tests/llm_chokepoint.rs:122 A member lost from the walk is skipped rather than named as could-not-run; removal_guard.rs:258 uses expect for the same read.

crates/core/tests/llm_chokepoint.rs:186 no_app_crate_can_name_the_researcher folds an unreadable file into not-an-offender and has no walked-file floor, so a moved crates/apps stays green; removal_guard.rs:267 asserts scanned > 50, this guard asserts nothing.
crates/core/tests/llm_chokepoint.rs:160 Both directions of the EXPECTED set are enforced, so a row with no live call site goes red; the compiler-enforced pub(crate) boundary is the stronger half.
crates/core/tests/llm_chokepoint.rs:96 Prose documenting the chokepoint is excluded so the detector does not fire on correct content.
crates/core/tests/llm_chokepoint.rs:156 The failure names the wrapper to call and the list to edit if the bypass is justified.
crates/core/tests/llm_chokepoint.rs:52 Each exemption is one exact path::receiver site, and a stale entry fails the test.
crates/core/tests/eval_tier3_extraction.rs:13 The blocking eval reads frozen fixtures and recorded transcripts only, so its verdict is a function of the tree.

crates/server/src/routes/doctor.rs:172 The route declares what it did not gather instead of handing over an empty list that reads as clean.
crates/server/src/routes/meta.rs:1345 The source guard asserts its own population floor before judging.
